title: Dr. Walter Fuchs

page_data.en:
SECRET
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S.I, Special Branch
REPORT
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S/B REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. 9969
Date April 20, 1940.

Subject Dr. Walter FUCHS, German Jew.

Made by D.S. Kitts Forwarded by D.I. Crawford.

Dr. Walter FUCHS, German Jew, ex-German
Consul in Shanghai, was a member of the German
Consular Service for some twenty years, his services
terminating in 1933 with the accession to power of
Herr Hitler and the removal of all non-Aryans from
public offices.

FUCHS arrived in Shanghai as Consul in
either 1930 or 1931, prior to which he had been
attached for lengthy periods to the Consulate-
General in Singapore and Addis Ababa.

During the time he held office in
Shanghai he was well respected and was considered
a very efficient official. He had two bad traits,
if such they can be termed. One was that he was
inclined to be rather talkative about business
affairs and the second that he was effeminate in
his habits, the use of a suspicion of rouge and
powder on his face giving rise to thoughts that he
was homosexually inclined, beliefs, however, which
have never been confirmed.

Upon the termination of his Consular
career in 1933 he was granted a modest pension by
the German Government. In recent years, however,
due to the incidence of German export currency
regulations, FUCHS has not been in receipt of this
stipend, since it is only paid in Germany where it
may be utilized.

（左侧手写批注：Copy recd.）
（左下角印章：INDEXED BY (S.B.) REGISTRY DATE 22/ 4/ 40）

报告
上海公共租界工部局警务处
特别科登记处
编号：S. B. D. 9969
日期：1940年4月20日。

事由：沃尔特·富克斯博士（Dr. Walter FUCHS），德籍犹太人。

撰写人：D.S. Kitts 转呈人：D.I. Crawford。

沃尔特·富克斯博士，德籍犹太人，前德国驻上海领事，曾在德国领事服务机构任职约二十年，其职务于1933年随着希特勒先生上台掌权以及所有非雅利安人被清除出公职而终止。

富克斯于1930年或1931年以领事身份抵达上海，在此之前，他曾长期派驻新加坡和亚的斯亚贝巴的总领事馆。

在上海任职期间，他备受尊敬，被认为是一位非常干练的官员。他有两个不良习性，如果可以这样称呼的话。一是他在谈论公务时往往过于健谈；二是他的生活习惯带有女性化倾向，脸上疑似使用胭脂和粉扑，使人联想到他有同性恋倾向，然而这些看法从未得到证实。

1933年其领事生涯结束后，德国政府给予了他一笔微薄的养老金。然而近年来，由于德国出口外汇管制条例的实施，富克斯一直未收到这笔津贴，因为该津贴仅在德国支付，且只能在当地使用。

（左侧手写批注：收到副本。）
（左下角印章：由特别科登记处索引 日期 1940年4月22日）

Made by........................................Forwarded by........................................

He conducted a manufacturer's agency in
1934 and 1935 without a great deal of financial
success and later acted as a correspondent for
certain European newspapers and magazines.

More recently he has been operating as
a lawyer from 717 Liza Building, 346 Szechuen Road.
He has, however, never been admitted to practise in
any local courts, all his cases being presented by
Chinese lawyers. His business is not flourishing,
but he is able to make sufficient to live decently.

A bachelor, FUCHS does not appear to have
any vices for he leads a very quiet and reserved
existence. From the time he arrived in Shanghai
until the outbreak of the China Incident, he resided
at the Astor House Hotel since when he moved to the
Park Hotel where he occupies Room 1307. He is not
well off and is more or less forced to lead a quiet
life since his financial position will not allow him
to do otherwise. He is given a very low rate by the
Park Hotel management and he meets his commitments
regularly.

He has few friends in Shanghai and these
he sees but rarely. Outside office hours, he spends
most of his time in the Park Hotel lounge reading.

Enquiries in various circles have failed
to reveal anything important that could be held
against him, though each avenue of information lays
stress on the fact that he is not well-to-do

1934年和1935年，他经营一家制造商代理行，但财务上并未取得多大成功，后来担任某些欧洲报纸和杂志的通讯员。

近期，他在四川路346号利查大楼（Liza Building）717室以律师身份执业。然而，他从未获准在任何本地法院出庭辩护，所有案件均由中国律师代为呈堂。他的业务并不兴隆，但他足以维持体面的生活。

富克斯是单身，似乎没有任何恶习，因为他过着非常安静和内敛的生活。从抵达上海到“中国事变”爆发期间，他住在汇中饭店（Astor House Hotel），此后搬至国际饭店（Park Hotel），居住于1307室。他并不富裕，由于经济状况不允许他过其他生活，或多或少被迫过着清静的日子。国际饭店管理层给予他很低的费率，他能定期履行付款义务。

他在上海朋友很少，且极少见面。下班后，他大部分时间都在国际饭店的大厅里阅读。

在各方面的调查未能发现任何针对他的重要不利信息，尽管各个信息来源都强调他并不富裕这一事实。

23 2 43

Central Station. File No. Misc. 98/43. Date 18/2/43.

SUBJECT: Report; Re attached note.

Sir,

With reference to the attached note, I beg to report that at about 9.30a.m. on 16/2/43, the under-signed proceeded to the Bank of Chosen Building (former Chase Bank) 346 Szechuen Road with a view to check up the Jewish people owned office; and it was ascertained that one Dr. Walter Fuchs occupied Room 717 of the said Building as an Attorney-at-Law, and he stated the same stories as to the attached letter and that he served more than 25 years in the German Government until the order of racial-legislation of the Reich for Jewish people was issued. At the time of issuing of the order he was appointed as a Consul of the German Consulate General in Shanghai.

SHANGHAI, CHINA February 16th, 1943.

To the
Shanghai Municipal Police. Shanghai.

Sirs ,

With reference to a personal call which I received this
morning of an officer,(a Japanese gentleman),making certain in-
quiries about my status, I have the honour to enclose herewith
a copy of a statement concerning the essential facts of my life.

It did not come into my mind during the call that I had this
statement at hand, but as it might serve for further information
on the subject, I would not fail to forward it to you for further
reference.

I have the honour to be,

Sirs,

Your obedient Servant
Walter Fuchs

中国上海 1943年2月16日。

致
上海公共租界工部局警务处。上海。

先生们，

鉴于今天上午我接待了一位警官（一位日本绅士）的私人拜访，并就我的身份进行了一些询问，荣幸地随函附上关于我生平基本事实的声明副本。

在拜访期间，我并未想到手头有这份声明，但既然它可能有助于提供有关此事的进一步信息，我不妨将其呈送贵处，以供进一步参考。

谨此致敬，

先生们，

您顺从的仆人
沃尔特·富克斯

page_data.en:
DR. WALTER FUCHS
SHANGHAI

Dr.Walter Fuchs ,

born in Tarnowitz,Upper-Silesia,Germany,on Mar ch 27,1888, of an old German family. Local Grammar School (Realgymnasium).

1906-10 studied Law and National Economics at the Universities of Geneva,Paris,Fribourg,Munich and Berlin. 1910 ,first State-Examination for future judges,lawyers to be admitted to the Bar and officers of the higher administration service of the Reich.

1910-14 attached to different courts of justice (as Referendar), practicing law and,at the same time,doing researchwork at different Universities. 1912,graduated as doctor of laws (Dr.jur.) and 1913,as doctor of National Economics (political science,- Dr. rer.pol.), both with honours (magna cum laude).

1914 Second State-Examination (Assessor-Examen),with honours, thus qualified as full fledged judge,higher Government's officer and lawyer to be called to the Bar.

1914-18 in the World War,Western Front, as lieutenant and first lieutenant of the Field-Artillery and later the Air Forces; decorated with the Iron Cross Ist class at an early date,and other decorations.

1919 appointed judge at the Court of Appeal at Ratibor,Silesia,Germany.

1920 called to the Foreign Office,Berlin.

1922-25 Secretary of the German Legation in Adis Abeba,Abyssinia;1924-25 Charge d'Affaires there.
1926 Secretary of Legation,Foreign Office,attached to the German Delegations of the International River Commissions (Rhine,Danube,Elbe), travelling widely over Europe.
1927 Secretary of the German Legation in Athens,Greece, from where sent to Alexandria,Egypt,in charge of the Consulate there.
1928 Attached to the German Consulate General in Singapore,from where sent to Soerabaia,Java,in charge of the Consulate there.

1929 transferred to the German Consulate General in Shanghai,China, as Consul,specially in charge of the legal matters,but also working in all other sections of the service,-land affairs,Community matters, economic reports;Press; member of the German Court of Arbitration, mostly presiding.
1934 , January 1st, put on the retired list,in conformity with the - i.e.racial - legislation of the Reich, no other individual reasons having been given or coming into question.(Pension has been paid and transferred until 1938,then paid into blocked account in Germany).
1938, established as a lawyer (attorney-at-law) in Shanghai.

Bachelor.- Author of a compendium of Abyssinian Law and of many other articles on various subjects.Travelled extensively over Africa and China. Interested in all things Chinese and problems of the Far East.
Speaks German,English,French fluently, and has a certain knowledge of Italian.

沃尔特·富克斯博士
上海

沃尔特·富克斯博士，

1888年3月27日出生于德国上西里西亚塔尔诺维茨（Tarnowitz），出身于一个古老的德国家庭。就读于当地文法学校（实科中学）。

1906-10年 在日内瓦、巴黎、弗里堡、慕尼黑和柏林的大学学习法律和国民经济。1910年，通过第一次国家考试，获得未来法官、获准执业律师及帝国高级行政官员资格。

1910-14年 隶属于不同司法机关（作为见习法官），从事法律实践，同时在不同大学进行研究性工作。1912年获法学博士（Dr.jur.）学位，1913年获国民经济学博士（政治学，Dr. rer.pol.）学位，均以优等成绩（magna cum laude）毕业。

1914年 以优等成绩通过第二次国家考试（候补法官考试），从而具备正式法官、高级政府官员及获准执业律师的资格。

1914-18年 参加世界大战，在西线战场，任野战炮兵中尉和上尉，后转入空军；早期即获颁一级铁十字勋章及其他勋章。

1919年 被任命为德国西里西亚拉蒂博尔（Ratibor）上诉法院法官。

1920年 调入柏林外交部。

1922-25年 任德国驻阿比西尼亚亚的斯亚贝巴公使馆秘书；1924-25年任该地代办。
1926年 任外交部公使馆秘书，隶属于德国国际河流委员会（莱茵河、多瑙河、易北河）代表团，广泛游历欧洲。
1927年 任德国驻希腊雅典公使馆秘书，随后被派往埃及亚历山大港，负责当地领事馆事务。
1928年 隶属于德国驻新加坡总领事馆，随后被派往爪哇泗水，负责当地领事馆事务。

1929年 调任德国驻中国上海总领事馆领事，专门负责法律事务，但也参与服务的所有其他部门工作——土地事务、社区事务、经济报告；新闻；德国仲裁法庭成员，大多担任主席。
1934年1月1日，根据帝国的——即种族——立法被列入退休名单，未给出或其他考虑其他个人原因。（养老金支付并汇出至1938年，随后存入德国的冻结账户）。
1938年，在上海以律师（执业律师）身份开业。

单身。——阿比西尼亚法律概要及许多其他主题文章的作者。广泛游历非洲和中国。对中国事物及远东问题感兴趣。
流利掌握德语、英语、法语，并具备一定的意大利语知识。
